speak: Corporation's name.
Business number. 9 digits, 2 letters, and 4 digits.
Tax year-end. Year 4 digits. Month 2 digits. Day 2 digits.
Line 100. General rate income pool (GRIP) at the end of the previous tax year.
Line 110. Taxable income for the year. Deposit insurance corporations (DICs) enter 0.
Line 130. Amount on line 400, 405, 410, or 428 of the T2 return, whichever is the least.
Line 140. For a Canadian-controlled private corporation (CCPC), the lesser of aggregate investment income, line 440 of the T2 return, and taxable income.
Amount A. Subtotal. Line 130 plus line 140. Instance 1.
Amount A. Instance 2.
Line 150. Income taxable at the general corporate rate. Line 110 minus amount A. If negative enter 0.
Line 190. After-tax income. Line 150 multiplied by 0.72, the general rate factor for the tax year.
Line 200. Eligible dividends received in the tax year.
Line 210. Dividends deductible under section 113 received in the tax year.
Amount B. Subtotal. Line 200 plus line 210. Instance 1.
Amount B. Instance 2.
Line 220. Becoming a CCPC, amount W5 in Part 4.
Line 230. Post-amalgamation. Total of amount E4 in Part 3 and amount W5 in Part 4.
Line 240. Post-wind-up. Total of amount E4 in Part 3 and amount W5 in Part 4.
Line 290. Subtotal. Add lines 220, 230, and 240. Instance 1.
Line 290. Instance 2.
Amount C. Subtotal. Add lines 100, 190, 290, and amount B.
Line 300. Eligible dividends paid in the previous tax year.
Line 310. Excessive eligible dividend designations made in the previous tax year. If becoming a CCPC, subsection 89(4) applies, enter 0 on lines 300 and 310.
Amount D. Subtotal. Line 300 minus line 310. Instance 1.
Amount D. Instance 2.
Line 490. GRIP before adjustment for specified future tax consequences. Amount C minus amount D. Amount can be negative.
Line 560. Total GRIP adjustment for specified future tax consequences to previous tax years. Amount L3 in Part 2.
Line 590. GRIP at the end of the tax year. Line 490 minus line 560. Enter this amount on line 160 of Schedule 55, Part III.1 Tax on Excessive Eligible Dividend Designations.
Amount A1. Taxable income before specified future tax consequences from the current tax year.
Amount B1. Amount on line 400, 405, 410, or 428 of the T2 return, whichever is the least.
Amount C1. Aggregate investment income. Line 440 of the T2 return.
Amount D1. Subtotal. Amount B1 plus amount C1. Instance 1.
Amount D1. Instance 2.
Amount E1. Subtotal. Amount A1 minus amount D1. If negative, enter 0. Instance 1.
Amount E1. Instance 2.
Amount F1. Taxable income after specified future tax consequences.
Amount G1. Amount on line 400, 405, 410, or 428 of the T2 return, whichever is the least.
Amount H1. Aggregate investment income. Line 440 of the T2 return.
Amount I1. Subtotal. Amount G1 plus amount H1. Instance 1.
Amount I1. Instance 2.
Amount J1. Subtotal. Amount F1 minus amount I1. If negative, enter 0. Instance 1.
Amount J1. Instance 2.
Amount K1. Subtotal amount E1 minus amount J1. If negative, enter 0.
Line 500. GRIP adjustment for specified future tax consequences to the first previous tax year. Amount K1 multiplied by 0.72.
Amount A2. Taxable income before specified future tax consequences from the current tax year.
Amount B2. Amount on line 400, 405, 410, or 428 of the T2 return, whichever is the least.
Amount C2. Aggregate investment income. Line 440 of the T2 return.
Amount D2. Subtotal. Amount B2 plus amount C2. Instance 1.
Amount D2. Instance 2.
Amount E2. Subtotal. Amount A2 minus amount D2. If negative, enter 0. Instance 1.
Amount E2. Instance 2.
Amount F2. Taxable income after specified future tax consequences.
Amount G2. Amount on line 400, 405, 410, or 428 of the T2 return, whichever is the least.
Amount H2. Aggregate investment income. Line 440 of the T2 return.
Amount I2. Subtotal. Amount G2 plus amount H2. Instance 1.
Amount I2. Instance 2.
Amount J2. Subtotal. Amount F2 minus amount I2. If negative, enter 0. Instance 1.
Amount J2. Instance 2.
Amount K2. Subtotal. Amount E2 minus amount J2. If negative, enter 0.
Line 520. GRIP adjustment for specified future tax consequences to the second previous tax year. Amount K2 multiplied by 0.72.
Amount A3. Taxable income before specified future tax consequences from the current tax year.
Amount B3. Amount on line 400, 405, 410, or 428 of the T2 return, whichever is the least.
Amount C3. Aggregate investment income. Line 440 of the T2 return.
Amount D3. Subtotal. Amount B3 plus amount C3. Instance 1.
Amount D3. Instance 2.
Amount E3. Subtotal. Amount A3 minus amount D3. If negative, enter 0. Instance 1.
Amount E3. Instance 2.
Amount F3. Taxable income after specified future tax consequences.
Amount G3. Amount on line 400, 405, 410, or 428 of the T2 return, whichever is the least.
Amount H3. Aggregate investment income. Line 440 of the T2 return.
Amount I3. Subtotal. Amount G3 plus amount H3. Instance 1.
Amount I3. Instance 2.
Amount J3. Subtotal. Amount F3 minus amount I3. If negative, enter 0. Instance 1.
Amount J3. Instance 2.
Amount K3. Subtotal. Amount E3 minus amount J3. If negative, enter 0.
Line 540. GRIP adjustment for specified future tax consequences to the third previous tax year. Amount K3 multiplied by 0.72.
Amount L3. Total GRIP adjustment for specified future tax consequences to previous tax years. Add lines 500, 520, and 540. If negative, enter 0. Enter amount L3 on line 560 in part 1.
Amount A4. Corporation's GRIP at the end of its last tax year.
Amount B4. Eligible dividends paid by the corporation in its last tax year.
Amount C4. Excessive eligible dividend designations made by the corporation in its last tax year.
Amount D4. Subtotal. Amount B4 minus amount C4. Instance 1.
Amount D4. Instance 2.
Amount E4. GRIP addition post-amalgamation or post-wind-up. Predecessor or subsidiary was a CCPC or a DIC in its last tax year. Amount A4 minus amount D4.
Amount A5. Cost amount to the corporation of all property immediately before the end of its previous or last tax year.
Amount B5. The corporation's money on hand immediately before the end of its previous or last tax year.
Amount C5. Non-capital losses.
Amount D5. Net capital losses.
Amount E5. Farm losses.
Amount F5. Restricted farm losses.
Amount G5. Limited partnership losses.
Amount H5. Subtotal. Add amounts C5 to G5. Instance 1.
Amount H5. Instance 2.
Amount I5. Non-capital losses.
Amount J5. Net capital losses.
Amount K5. Farm losses.
Amount L5. Restricted farm losses.
Amount M5. Limited partnership losses.
Amount N5. Subtotal. Add amounts I5 to M5. Instance 1.
Amount N5. Instance 2.
Amount O5. Unused and unexpired losses at the end of the corporation's previous or last tax year. Amount H5 minus amount N5. Instance 1.
Amount O5. Instance 2.
Amount P5. Subtotal. Add amounts A5, B5, and O5.
Amount Q5. All the corporation's debts and other obligations to pay that were outstanding immediately before the end of its previous or last tax year.
Amount R5. Paid-up capital of all the corporation's issued and outstanding shares of capital stock immediately before the end of its previous or last tax year.
Amount S5. All the corporation's reserves deducted in its previous or last tax year.
Amount T5. The corporation's capital dividend account immediately before the end of its previous or last tax year.
Amount U5. The corporation's low rate income pool immediately before the end of its previous or last tax year.
Amount V5. Subtotal. Add amounts Q5 to U5. Instance 1.
Amount V5. Instance 2.

Amount W5. GRIP addition post-amalgamation or post-wind-up. Predecessor or subsidiary was not a CCPC or a DIC in its last tax year, or the corporation is becoming a CCPC. Amount P5 minus amount V5. If negative, enter 0.
